lcc_original: 亞當和妻子夏娃同房，夏娃就懷孕，生了該隱，便說：『由於永恆主的庇佑【1】我得了一個男兒』；
notes: UNV opens with 有一日 (untagged) which has no equivalent in LCC — cleanly absent with no SN loss.
亞當 (LCC) replaces 那人 (UNV) for H0120; both refer to Adam, so the mapping is unambiguous.
UNV 和<WH0853> maps to LCC 和 directly — both serve as the surface rendering of the direct-object marker אֵת before 夏娃.
Second {H0853} (before 該隱) remains implicit in LCC as no explicit particle appears; braces preserved per Rule 4.
{H0854} is implicit in UNV but LCC renders the preposition אֵת explicitly as 由於; braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached to 由於.
LCC 的庇佑 (protection/blessing) is an interpretive expansion by Lü with no Hebrew lexeme; left unannotated.
【1】 is a footnote marker native to LCC; preserved in place between 庇佑 and 我.
LCC 男兒 (male child) corresponds to UNV 男子 for H0376 (אִישׁ); semantic equivalence clear.
